name: Borscht
effect:
Decreases the rate of Sheer Cold accumulation for all party members for 900s.
In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
description: A vibrant red soup dish. Once the broth is ready, various ingredients are added in batches and slow-simmered until their flavors meld. A spoonful of sour cream is often added just before serving. With every sip, a steady warmth spreads through the body, enough to keep the bitter cold at bay.

suspicious.effect: Slightly decreases the rate of Sheer Cold accumulation for all party members for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
suspicious.description: A vibrant red soup dish. Everything about this dish feels half-hearted, looking as if someone simply dumped the leftover ingredients from a previous meal into the pot. Finishing it does make you feel somewhat warmer than before, but it is like a single match being struck, bringing nothing more than a fleeting moment of warmth.

delicious.effect: Decreases the rate of Sheer Cold accumulation for all party members for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
delicious.description: A vibrant red soup. The moment the hot broth slides down your throat, a soothing warmth takes hold, as if someone has lit a fire inside your chest. The heat quietly spreads until even the tips of your ears are warm. When trekking through a raging blizzard, this bowl of soup is worth far more than wrapping yourself in an extra coat!
